acceptance: morize-core exports BoundedUtf8 and Utf8BoundsError from one new bounded-value module, with no additional public domain behavior.
BoundedUtf8<4> accepts empty text, four ASCII bytes, and two two-byte UTF-8 characters, while rejecting five-byte inputs with Utf8BoundsError::TooLong { max_bytes: 4, actual_bytes: 5 }.
MAX_BYTES=0 accepts only empty text; all rejected inputs fail without truncation or content mutation.
Owned String construction, borrowed-str construction, and FromStr enforce the same byte-bound contract and accepted text round-trips byte-for-byte through as_str and into_string.
Display emits the contained text exactly, while Debug does not contain the text and reports only bounded metadata.
Equality, ordering, and hashing depend only on the preserved string value and do not normalize, trim, or case-fold text.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and includes focused ASCII, multibyte, zero-limit, no-truncation, preservation, and Debug non-disclosure tests.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain admits no runtime, build, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for byte-bound correctness, no-truncation behavior, UTF-8 preservation, Debug non-disclosure, scope containment, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite for SG-000011 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.
The implementation changes no path outside crates/morize-core/src/bounded.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free bounded UTF-8 value/error module, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No field-specific limits, normalization, serde, persistence, collections, timestamps, or domain behavior is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, byte-bound semantics, no-truncation behavior, Debug redaction, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the bounded UTF-8 primitive implementation commits; no persisted format, migration, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: A single standard-library-only generic bounded UTF-8 value inside existing morize-core is the narrowest reusable implementation. It avoids choosing field limits, Unicode policy, persistence formats, or third-party libraries prematurely.

outcome: morize-core exposes a dependency-free BoundedUtf8<const MAX_BYTES: usize> value that enforces a hard UTF-8 byte ceiling without truncation or normalization, provides deterministic value semantics, and avoids exposing contained text through Debug.
rationale: P1 explicitly requires bounded strings, and DATA_MODEL serialization invariants require bounded field sizes. This Grain adds only the reusable in-memory UTF-8 byte-bound primitive; field-specific limits, normalization rules, persistence, serialization, collections, timestamps, and domain records remain separate decisions.

risk.recovery: Revert the bounded UTF-8 primitive implementation commits; no persistent format or user data has been written by this Grain.

scope_in: Define public BoundedUtf8<const MAX_BYTES: usize> with private owned UTF-8 string storage and an exact byte-count ceiling.
Provide one bounded public Utf8BoundsError::TooLong { max_bytes, actual_bytes } error that never includes the rejected text.
Provide checked construction from owned String and borrowed str, FromStr, as_str, len_bytes, is_empty, into_string, max_bytes, Display, AsRef<str>, and deterministic Eq/Ord/Hash value semantics.
Make Debug metadata-only: it may expose the configured maximum and actual byte length but not the contained text.

Add standard-library-only tests for empty input, exact ASCII boundary, over-limit ASCII, multibyte UTF-8 byte boundaries, zero-byte limits, no truncation, byte preservation, value semantics, and Debug non-disclosure.
scope_out: Unicode normalization, case folding, trimming, control-character policy, locale behavior, grapheme/code-point limits, or field-specific validation.
Field-specific aliases or maximums, collections, timestamps, content digests, domain records, identity behavior, policy, storage, retrieval, MCP, or model behavior.
Serde or other serialization-framework integration, persisted schemas, configuration formats, wire contracts, migrations, or any third-party dependency.
title: Add bounded UTF-8 text primitive
